confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from a few web search results. Saranda-specific data was sparse, so the figures lean on Tirana, Vlorë and Himara benchmarks, adjusted upward for July coastal seasonality. The inexpensive meal and wine figures are the least certain of the food anchors because their sources disagree. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Saranda context, not from live listings or booking pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Albanian coastal resort towns (Vlorë, Himara) and Tirana price levels, with Saranda's summer peak premium applied; accommodation is a holistic estimate for a southern Albanian Riviera resort in peak season.
